// Jasmine's job search profile
const profile = {
  name: 'Jasmine Mack',
  titles: [
    'AI Operations Manager', 'AI Operations Director', 'Creative Technologist',
    'AI Workflow Lead', 'Automation Lead', 'Learning Experience Designer',
    'AI Content Strategist', 'Prompt Engineer', 'AI Product Manager',
    'Narrative Designer', 'Instructional Designer', 'AI EdTech Consultant',
    'No-Code Solutions Architect', 'AI Tools Trainer', 'AI Enablement Specialist',
    'Creative Operations Manager', 'Technical Program Manager',
    'AI Curriculum Designer', 'Developer Advocate'
  ],
  skills: [
    'n8n', 'Make', 'Zapier', 'Zoho Flow', 'React', 'Vite', 'Tailwind',
    'Supabase', 'SQL', 'Netlify', 'ChatGPT', 'Midjourney', 'Higgsfield',
    'CapCut', 'Anthropic API', 'Claude API', 'Groq', 'Llama',
    'Google Sheets', 'ClickUp', 'Canvas LMS', 'Python', 'GitHub',
    'Zoho CRM', 'AI animation', 'prompt engineering', 'workflow automation'
  ],
  location:'Tampa FL or Sarasota FL',
  remote: true,
  hybrid: true,
  minSalary: 70000,
  industries: ['startups', 'creative agencies', 'edtech', 'sports tech', 'saas', 'nonprofit', 'media', 'health tech'],
  excludeIndustries: ['enterprise', 'fortune 500', 'staffing', 'recruiting agency'],
  dealbreakers: ['relocation required', 'staffing agency', 'pure sales', 'commission only']
};

// Search queries to rotate across sources
const queries = [
  'AI operations manager remote',
  'creative technologist remote',
  'AI workflow automation lead remote',
  'prompt engineer remote',
  'AI content strategist remote',
  'learning experience designer AI remote',
  'developer advocate AI tools remote',
  'no-code automation specialist remote',
  'AI operations Sarasota FL',
  'creative technologist Sarasota FL',
  'automation specialist Sarasota FL hybrid'
];

return [{ json: { profile, queries } }];
